faq_heading: Crescent Beach and Ocean Park houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park sell for?
faq.a: 107 houses sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,745,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park?
faq.a: The median was 26 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.9% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 107 houses that sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park went for between $1,482,500 and $2,137,000, around a median of $1,745,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park sell above asking price?
faq.a: 7% of the 107 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 95.9% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park?
faq.a: The median year built was 1986 for the 107 houses sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park had 4 bedrooms, from the 107 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

blocks.text: Crescent Beach and Ocean Park houses for sale now
What Crescent Beach and Ocean Park houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

107 houses sold in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park with a median price of $1,745,000 (the middle half sold between $1,482,500 and $2,137,000), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 95.9% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $652 per square foot, a median year built of 1986 and a median lot of 7,993 square feet.

blocks.text: How Crescent Beach and Ocean Park compares with the rest of South Surrey

The median house in Crescent Beach and Ocean Park sold for $1,745,000, about the same as the South Surrey median of $1,716,500 across 454 sales. Crescent Beach and Ocean Park houses took a median 26 days to sell, against 32 days for South Surrey as a whole.
